Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

pkginspectr (development version)

  • curl is now listed in Suggests: the network tests use it to check for an internet connection, and failed on CI without it.

pkginspectr 0.3.0

  • New pkg_functions() returns one row per named function: its file, location, start line, code lines, number of arguments and whether it is exported (via export() or exportPattern()). Useful for finding the largest functions or measuring how much of a package is internal.

  • New pkg_versions() lists every CRAN release of a package with its date, and pkg_history() runs pkg_summary() on several releases (spread evenly across the history by default, or the versions you name) to show how a package grew over time.

  • When several packages are analysed, one that fails (a typo, a failed download, an unreadable folder) no longer aborts the rest. It is reported in a single warning and kept as a row of NAs, so pkg_history() still returns every other release. A single package, or all packages, failing is still an error.

  • Results print a header saying what they contain, e.g. # pkginspectr: Lines of code, 3 packages (1 failed), matching the titles used by pkg_plot().

  • New “Derived metrics” section in vignette("pkginspectr") with copy-and-paste recipes for ratios such as test-to-code lines, comment density, share of code inside functions and help pages per export.

  • pkg_plot() shows non-integer values with at most three decimals, so derived metrics such as ratios stay readable.

pkginspectr 0.2.0

Lifecycle changes

  • All exported functions now share the pkg_ prefix and are named after what they return. The old names still work but are deprecated:

    • inspect_package() → pkg_structure()
    • get_code_stats() → pkg_lines()
    • plot_pkg() → pkg_plot()
    • clear_pkg_cache() → pkg_cache_clear()

Changes to results

  • pkg_lines() returns non-overlapping columns. code_lines, comment_lines, roxygen_lines and blank_lines add up to total_lines, and so do r_lines, test_lines and other_lines. function_lines now counts only code lines inside functions. The deprecated get_code_stats() keeps its original columns.

  • pkg_structure(): num_r_files, num_function_r_files and num_non_function_r_files now count only scripts in R/ (previously test and data-raw/ scripts were included).

  • Lines are now classified with R’s parser (utils::getParseData()) instead of regular expressions and brace counting. Functions assigned with =, \(x) lambdas and anonymous functions are counted; one-line functions no longer absorb the following line; {, } and # inside strings are no longer miscounted. Files that fail to parse produce a warning.

  • Only files that R CMD build would ship are counted: .Rbuildignore, version-control folders and R’s built-in exclusions are respected, so local folders and CRAN tarballs are comparable. Use the new include_ignored = TRUE argument to count .Rbuildignored files again.

  • Lower-case .r files, .Rnw vignettes and .rds/.csv/.tsv/.tab/.txt data files are now recognised.

New features

  • Clearer package sources in path:

    • Explicit prefixes local::, github:: and cran::. Unprefixed input still works, but a path that does not exist (e.g. "./mypkg") is now an error instead of a GitHub request.
    • GitHub refs ("r-lib/cli@v3.6.0"), subfolders ("github::owner/repo/subdir") and browser URLs (github.com/owner/repo/tree/<ref>/<subdir>).
    • Older CRAN releases ("cran::desc@1.4.0") and archived CRAN packages.

  • New cache argument ("session", "persistent" or "none"). The persistent cache keeps fixed versions (CRAN releases, GitHub commit SHAs and version tags) across R sessions; GitHub branches are always fetched fresh.

  • pkg_summary() returns pkg_structure() and pkg_lines() in one table, resolving and downloading each package only once.

  • plot() works on any pkginspectr result.

  • pkg_plot() documents all its styling arguments (text_col, bar_col, bg_col, glyph, start, end, max_bars, title), and both views accept the same set. Metric bars are scaled to each metric’s largest value, so packages are easy to compare. The package view groups metrics into “Files” (shares of num_files) and “Lines” (shares of total_lines), and shows num_dirs without a misleading percentage. Default titles describe the data.

  • pkg_structure(), pkg_lines() and pkg_summary() gain quiet = TRUE to suppress progress messages.

  • New pkginspectr_example() returns the path to a small example package bundled with pkginspectr, so examples run offline.

  • New “Get started” vignette: vignette("pkginspectr").

Bug fixes

  • GitHub downloads no longer use the GitHub API, so they are no longer limited to 60 requests per hour.

  • CRAN downloads work when no CRAN mirror is set (e.g. under Rscript), and no longer miss packages that need a newer R version.

  • Cached downloads are keyed by owner, repository and ref, so same-named repos from different owners no longer collide, and a failed download no longer leaves a broken cache entry behind.

  • Files are classified by their path relative to the package root. Previously a package stored under a folder named tests/, man/ or data/ had all of its files misclassified.

  • pkg_cache_clear() returns the cleared path (or NULL) invisibly, as documented, and its message no longer lists both cache types when called without arguments.

  • GitHub and CRAN lookups no longer fail when the suggested glue package is not installed; glue is no longer used.

Other

  • pkginspectr now requires R >= 4.1.0 and purrr >= 1.0.0, and no longer depends on tidyr or httr.

  • Examples no longer use \dontrun{} and no longer clear the persistent cache. Added GitHub Actions workflows for R CMD check and test coverage.

pkginspectr 0.1.0

  • Added inspect_package() which returns key statistics about an R package. In particular:

    • package: package name
    • version: version number
    • num_files: number of files in the package
    • num_dirs: number of directories in the package
    • num_r_files: number of R files in the package
    • num_function_r_files: number of R files containing functions
    • num_non_function_r_files: number of R files not containing functions
    • num_test_files: number of test files in the package
    • num_vignettes: number of vignettes in the package
    • num_docs: number of documentation files in the package
    • num_data_files: number of data files in the package

  • Added get_code_stats() which returns code statistics for an R package. In particular:

    • package: package name
    • version: version number
    • total_lines: total number of lines of code
    • blank_lines: total number of blank lines
    • comment_lines: total number of comment lines
    • roxygen_lines: total number of roxygen lines
    • function_lines: total number of lines within functions
    • test_lines: total number of lines within test files

  • Added plot_pkg() which plots output from inspect_package() or get_code_stats() in the console. Users can modify colours and shapes of the plot to make it uniquely theirs. It offers two modes type = "package" and type = "metric":

    • type = "package" plots package statistics for multiple packages grouped by package name.

    • type = "metric" plots package statistics grouped by metric.

  • pkginspectr retrieves package information from

    • local packages
    • CRAN, and
    • GitHub repositories.

  • Updated README.md with examples of how to use the package.

  • Added tests for all functions using testthat.

  • Create informative README.md.

pkginspectr 0.0.0.9000
